contract.multiplicity: preserve duplicate offsets and duplicate (offset,type) tuples
contract.oracle: exact full tuple comparison plus independent scalar std::lower_bound/access/seek; sums only prevent dead-code elimination

seeds.note: Public predetermined evaluation seeds, not a claim of blind testing. Freeze recipes before tuning. Separate RNG streams for positions/types/queries.

execution.queue: bounded to parallel_jobs; completion-driven, no idle polling
execution.isolation: Shared-host timings include contention; --parallel-jobs 1 results are separate.

measurement.pairing: same case/seed/process block, cyclic algorithm order (exact ordinal balance only over a complete cycle), rotated operation order
measurement.unit: fresh process for a case/algorithm/configuration/block; inner iterations are not independent replicates
measurement.construction: library initialization excluded and reported separately; typed-input adaptation included; validation outside timers
measurement.warm_cache: normal repeated process-local accesses; no claim of physical cold disk cache
measurement.statistics: median per process, paired ratios across process blocks; hierarchical bootstrap by case and process block within family; no pooled inner-loop confidence interval
measurement.memory: phase private bytes/working set and absolute Windows process high-water marks; bytes = actual encoded streams including type/directory/padding plus a common 64-byte accounting envelope, not an on-disk image; reported capacities are partial diagnostic lower bounds, unknown is null
measurement.io: Win32 transfer counters are process transfers, not physical storage-device bytes

release_gates.correctness: zero candidate errors on every mandatory case; unsupported cases remain in coverage denominator
release_gates.publication: all mandatory shards, all process blocks, pinned source/build/input manifests and external-data status disclosed; quick/conformance runs are exploratory
release_gates.winner: publish space/build/query/lifecycle Pareto fronts and worst strata; no universal winner or arbitrary single-score weight
release_gates.performance_decision: predeclare target effect and acceptable regressions for the intended workload before examining candidate results; confidence interval must resolve that effect

sources.use: author Uniform/ClusterData generators, length strata, decoding includes differential reconstruction
Access/Next/NextGEQ semantics, directory costs and query/build separation
run-rich and set workloads, run optimization and serialization costs
dense/sparse transitions and variable partition tradeoffs
